        return [entry for child in item for entry in flatten(child)]
    if isinstance(item, dict) and 'path' in item:
        return [item]

import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
out = Path(r'<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\runs\D-Q02-new-r2-v1')
manifest_path = out / 'loaded-resources.json'
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for entry in manifest:
    name = Path(entry['path']).name
    if name in ('check_voice.py', 'check_prose.py'):
        entry['use'] = 'read dependency-related lines; executed on first draft, revised draft, and final manuscript'
    elif name == 'count_words.py':
        entry['use'] = 'authored local support script; executed on first draft, revised draft, and final manuscript'
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(entry['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == entry['sha256']
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
expected = ['first-draft.md','revised-draft.md','self-review.md','final.md','rationale.md','writing-note.md','loaded-resources.json','input-file-hashes.json','executed-commands.json','first-draft.voice-check.txt','first-draft.prose-check.txt','revised-draft.voice-check.txt','revised-draft.prose-check.txt','final.voice-check.txt','final.prose-check.txt','word-counts.json']
for name in expected:
    text = (out / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert text.strip(), name
    assert '\ufffd' not in text, name
counts = json.loads((out / 'word-counts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert all(item['body_within_450_550'] for item in counts)
report = {'expected_files_verified':len(expected),'resource_hashes_verified':len(manifest),'final_body_words':counts[-1]['manuscript_body_words'],'attribution_heading_words':counts[-1]['attribution_heading_words'],'utf8_decode_ok':True}
(out / 'delivery-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report))
